# Repository Insights: espn-nhl-fantasy-2

Purpose
- Collects ESPN NHL fantasy league data (players, drafts, free agents) via espn_api and stores it in per-league SQLite DBs under `espn-data/<league_id>/`.
- Computes fantasy points, exports CSVs (Power BI friendly) and Excel workbooks with sparklines.

Top-level entrypoints
- app-console.py — interactive console to init or interact with leagues.
- src/get_players_draft_data.py — fetches data from ESPN API, writes to DB.
- src/init_league.py — creates league folder, DB, saves auth.json and scoring settings.
- dump_data_into_tables.py — exports DB tables to CSVs (PowerBI/Excel formats).
- csv_to_excel_workbook_with_sparklines.py — converts CSV dumps to an Excel workbook with sparklines.

Key modules (brief)
- src/espn_api_custom.py — small subclass adding free_agents() convenience method.
- src/schemas.py — DB schemas, espn-to-sqlite mapping, default scoring weights.
- src/player_stats_to_tables_converter.py — reads DB and computes FP and FP_AVG for each player/year.
- src/get_players_draft_data.py — publisher class that uses espn_api (espn_s2 + swid) to populate tables; adapts schema by adding missing columns.
- src/init_league.py — interactive flow for league setup and scoring; writes `espn-data/<league_id>/auth.json` and `league.db`.
- src/data_processor.py — small helpers (list leagues, years) used by console UI.
- dump_data_into_tables.py — DataExporter: builds CSVs for Power BI/Excel including summary tables and statistics.

Runtime data layout
- espn-data/<league_id>/auth.json  (contains espn_s2, swid — sensitive, do NOT commit)
- espn-data/<league_id>/league.db   (sqlite DB created by init_league)
- espn-data/<league_id>/dumps/*     (CSV and Excel export outputs)

How to use (examples)
- Initialize: `python app-console.py` → choose "Init a new league" (or run `python src/init_league.py`).
- Fetch/update data: `python src/get_players_draft_data.py --league_id 41610 [--full_history]`.
- Export CSVs: `python dump_data_into_tables.py -l <league_id> -y <year>` or use DataExporter.main.
- Generate Excel: `python csv_to_excel_workbook_with_sparklines.py -l <league_id> [--sparklines]`.

Dependencies
- Python 3.8+
- espn_api (third-party package)
- pandas, xlsxwriter (for Excel output)
- sqlite3 (stdlib)

Security notes
- `espn-data/*/auth.json` contains secrets (espn_s2, swid). Add `espn-data/*/auth.json` to .gitignore and avoid committing.

Maintenance suggestions
- Add requirements.txt (espn_api, pandas, xlsxwriter) and a short README install/run section.
- Consider migrating secret storage to env vars or a secrets manager instead of auth.json.
- Add .gitignore to exclude espn-data/*/auth.json and league DBs if desired.

Where to find details
- DB schema and column descriptions: `src/schemas.py`
- Column-calculation and FP logic: `src/player_stats_to_tables_converter.py`
- Data publishing / schema migration: `src/get_players_draft_data.py`
